countries.label: Egypt
countries.generalGuidance: If you are in immediate danger, or thoughts of harming yourself appear, or you feel you cannot keep yourself safe, contact one of the numbers below or someone you trust right away, and do not stay alone.

resources.label: Police
resources.note: When there is immediate danger or a threat. The unified number 112 also works from mobiles.

resources.label: Mental health hotline, from a landline
resources.note: General Secretariat of Mental Health and Addiction Treatment, Ministry of Health. Free from landlines.

resources.label: Mental health hotline, from a mobile
resources.note: The same service, for calls from a mobile phone.

countries.label: Another country
countries.generalGuidance: This app does not know the emergency numbers where you are, and will not show an unverified number. If you are in immediate danger, or thoughts of harming yourself appear, contact your local emergency number, go to the nearest hospital, or call someone you trust. Do not stay alone.
